procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
LTU 444 and GER 1700 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: The protest was delivered on 2. April 2026 at 18:39.
The protest time limit for division A on 2. April 2026 expired at 18:27.
conclusions: LTU 444 failed to deliver the protest within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 60.3(b)(1) and SI 18.2.
There was no good reason for the protest committee to extend the time limit. Therefore the protest is invalid under RRS 60.4(1)(a).
decision: The protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
